## What this does

Two pieces landed together in this branch (opening as one PR since they built on the same working tree):

### 1. Trace-free model roofline projection CLI
Adds `TraceLens_model_roofline_projection`: projects a kernel-by-kernel roofline (COMPUTE_BOUND/MEMORY_BOUND, time, unmodeled-op callouts) for a checkpoint from its config and modeling source alone — no trace or GPU run required. Reuses the Model Explorer AST backend and stops expansion at ops with a direct `TraceLens.PerfModel` formula.

- `TraceLens.ModelUtils.roofline_projection`: `RooflineOp`, `project_roofline`.
- `TraceLens.ModelUtils.roofline_cli`: the console script.
- `TraceLens.ModelUtils.cli_common`: shared `--engine`/`--code-path`/`--github`/runtime-regime argument helpers, factored out of the Model Explorer export CLI so both CLIs parse checkpoint sources alike.
- `basic_ops.ROOFLINE_LEAF_PATTERNS` / `loader.build_roofline_basic_ops`: the GEMM/CONV/Normalization/Softmax leaf set a roofline projection can cost.
- `tree_perf.compute_roofline_time_and_bound`: shared roofline bound/time formula.
- Docs: [`docs/how-to/generate-model-roofline-projection.md`](../blob/feat/gweisz_roofline_projection/docs/how-to/generate-model-roofline-projection.md), linked from the README and `perf-model-without-trace.md`.

### 2. Re-enable vLLM/SGLang modeling-class expansion
Follow-up to #1155 / #1156. Re-enables expanding a vLLM/SGLang modeling class into its real ops (instead of leaving it an opaque leaf), fixing the three gaps that previously blocked it:

- `ast_analyze`: detect a kernel boundary reached through a conditionally-assigned pluggable attribute (`self.quant_method.apply(...)`), not just a bare imported-class call; climb same-file base-class inheritance (`_resolve_inherited_forward`) so a subclass with no `forward` of its own (`MergedColumnParallelLinear(ColumnParallelLinear)`) is analyzed as its base; thread the analyzed module's own name through a new `ANALYZED_MODULE_KEY` config key instead of hardcoding transformers'.
- `source`/`extract`: register vLLM's and SGLang's own pinned-source fetches (`resolve_engine_modeling_files`) the same way transformers' modeling files already were, so a model's sibling imports resolve at the same pinned commit instead of falling back to an unavailable `sys.path` lookup — the actual reason cross-file class resolution never worked for these engines before.
- `shape_inference`: extend `QKVParallelLinear`'s output-width formula to its indexer subclass (`...WithIndexer`), which the inheritance climb above now reaches.

Expanding more classes surfaced two further wiring gaps, fixed at their root:

- `computation_graph._add_kernel_port_nodes` read every repeat of a `(source, target)` link off the same dict key, so q/k/v split outputs feeding a newly kernel-tagged attention call collapsed onto one port and the rest were left as I1 dead nodes. Each repeat now resolves its own entry off the parallel ports list.
- `type_check._kernel_interface_tile_warnings` flagged a kernel whose output fed two allocation calls (`qkv.new_empty(...)` borrowing `qkv`'s dtype as a buffer template) as if it were a kernel returning several untiled values. Allocation-call readers never read the kernel's value, so they no longer count toward that check.

`overview`/`shapes`/`ast_build`/`merge`/`parallel_plan` pick up the same class expansion elsewhere it changes what the graph now sees.

Deliberately out of scope: a *general* pinned-source/class-expansion mechanism beyond the vLLM/SGLang engines above (risk of a `quant_method.apply()`-style regression for other engines not yet audited).

## Verification

- Verified end-to-end against `MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3` via vLLM: zero dead nodes, zero type-check warnings beyond one pre-existing, already-investigated shape-inference passthrough notice.
- `tests/ModelUtils/` + `tests/Visualizer/`: 2567 passed.
- Full `tests/` suite: only pre-existing, environment-dependent failures (missing `jax`/`triton` in this sandbox); none touch `ModelUtils`/`Visualizer`.
- `black --check .` and the copyright-header check are clean.

Opening as draft — marking ready once a final pass settles on whether the two pieces above should ship as one PR or split.

+    ``args.stop_at_roofline_ops`` when the caller added

+``TraceLens.PerfModel`` formula, and prints a kernel-by-kernel roofline table
+plus a model-level rollup -- no trace or GPU run required.
+"""

+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse
+import csv

+from TraceLens.Agent.Analysis.utils.arch_utils import list_platforms, load_arch
+from TraceLens.ModelUtils.cli_common import (
+    add_engine_argument,

+)

+
+# Constants
+
+_TABLE_COLUMNS = (
+    "section",
+    "name",
+    "category",
+    "instances",
+    "total_flops",

+)

+
+def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:

+def parse_dim_overrides(entries: list[str]) -> dict[str, int]:
+    """Parse ``--dim KEY=VALUE`` pairs into an int-valued dict."""
+    overrides: dict[str, int] = {}
+    for entry in entries:
+        key, sep, value = entry.partition("=")
+        if not sep or not key.strip():
+            raise ValueError(f"--dim must be KEY=VALUE, got {entry!r}")
+        try:
+            overrides[key.strip()] = int(value.strip())
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            raise ValueError(f"--dim value must be an int, got {entry!r}") from exc
+    return overrides
+
+
+def _op_row(op: RooflineOp) -> dict[str, object]:
+    return {
+        "section": op.section,
+        "name": op.name,
+        "computation": op.computation,
+        "category": op.category,
+        "instances": op.instances,
+        "flops": op.flops,
+        "bytes": op.bytes,
+        "total_flops": op.total_flops,
+        "total_bytes": op.total_bytes,
+        "compute_spec": op.compute_spec,
+        "roofline_bound": op.roofline_bound,
+        "roofline_time_us": op.roofline_time_us,
+        "total_roofline_time_us": op.total_roofline_time_us,
+        "reason": op.reason,
+    }
+
+
+def format_table(ops: list[RooflineOp], *, top_n: int) -> str:
+    """Render a fixed-width table of *ops*, ranked by total roofline time."""
+    ranked = sorted(ops, key=lambda op: op.total_roofline_time_us or 0, reverse=True)
+    if top_n > 0:
+        ranked = ranked[:top_n]
+    rows = [_op_row(op) for op in ranked]
+    widths = {
+        col: (
+            max(len(col), *(len(_format_cell(row[col])) for row in rows))
+            if rows
+            else len(col)
+        )
+        for col in _TABLE_COLUMNS
+    }
+    lines = [" | ".join(col.ljust(widths[col]) for col in _TABLE_COLUMNS)]
+    lines.append("-+-".join("-" * widths[col] for col in _TABLE_COLUMNS))
+    for row in rows:
+        lines.append(
+            " | ".join(
+                _format_cell(row[col]).ljust(widths[col]) for col in _TABLE_COLUMNS
+            )
+        )
+    return "\n".join(lines)
+
+
+def _format_cell(value: object) -> str:
+    if value is None:
+        return "-"
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return f"{value:,.1f}"
+    return str(value)
+
+
+def write_csv(ops: list[RooflineOp], path: Path) -> None:
+    rows = [_op_row(op) for op in ops]
+    fieldnames = list(rows[0].keys()) if rows else []
+    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        writer = csv.DictWriter(handle, fieldnames=fieldnames)
+        writer.writeheader()
+        writer.writerows(rows)
+

+def main(argv: list[str] | None = None) -> int:

+    if checkpoint is None and args.github is None:

+visualizer draws -- not a second, independently-matched approximation of it.

+projection's coverage is always visible instead of assumed.

+        base.output_elements = output_elements
+        return _finish_op(base, category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch)
+
+    try:
+        output_shape = resolve_shape(_dims_only, dims)
+        base.output_elements = prod(output_shape) if output_shape else 1
+    except DimResolutionError as exc:
+        base.reason = f"unresolved output dim {exc}"
+        return base
+
+    try:
+        input_shapes = [
+            resolve_shape(shape, dims) if shape else None for shape in input_texts
+        ]
+        cost = _dispatch_op_cost(computation, input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    except DimResolutionError as exc:
+        base.reason = f"unresolved input dim {exc}"
+        return base
+
+    if cost is None:
+        base.reason = f"no PerfModel mapping for computation={computation!r}"
+        return base
+
+    category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved = cost
+    return _finish_op(base, category, maf_type, flops, bytes_moved, dtype, gpu_arch)
+
+
+def _finish_op(
+    base: RooflineOp,
+    category: str,
+    maf_type: str,
+    flops: float,
+    bytes_moved: float | None,
+    dtype: str | None,
+    gpu_arch: dict[str, Any] | None,
+) -> RooflineOp:
+    base.category = category
+    base.modeled = True
+    base.flops = flops
+    base.bytes = bytes_moved
+
+    precision = torch_dtype_map(dtype) if dtype else None
+    if precision is not None:
+        base.compute_spec = f"{maf_type}_{precision}"
+    if gpu_arch is not None and base.compute_spec is not None and flops:
+        peak_tflops = (gpu_arch.get("max_achievable_tflops") or {}).get(
+            base.compute_spec
+        )
+        mem_bw_gbps = gpu_arch.get("mem_bw_gbps")
+        gflops = flops / 1e9
+        roofline_time_us, roofline_bound = compute_roofline_time_and_bound(
+            gflops, bytes_moved, peak_tflops, mem_bw_gbps
+        )
+        base.roofline_time_us = roofline_time_us
+        base.roofline_bound = roofline_bound
+    return base
+
+
+def _engine_boundary_cost(
+    class_name: str,
+    dims: dict[str, Any],
+    moe_top_k: int | None,
+    moe_intermediate_size: int | None,
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None, int] | None:
+    """``(category, maf_type, flops, bytes, output_elements)`` for a vLLM/SGLang
+    boundary shape_inference has no rule for, or ``None`` when *class_name*
+    names neither one (see the module docstring's approximations)."""
+    if any(marker in class_name for marker in _ENGINE_HEAD_CLASS_MARKERS):
+        return _engine_head_cost(dims, bpe)
+    if any(marker in class_name for marker in _ENGINE_MOE_CLASS_MARKERS):
+        return _moe_cost(dims, moe_top_k, moe_intermediate_size, bpe)
+    return None
+
+
+def _engine_head_cost(
+    dims: dict[str, Any], bpe: float | None
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None, int] | None:
+    """GEMM cost of the vocab projection a ``ParallelLMHead`` performs via its
+    pluggable ``quant_method`` (never its own ``forward``, which only raises)."""
+    try:
+        tokens = resolve_dim(dims["B"], dims) * resolve_dim(dims["S"], dims)
+        vocab = resolve_dim(dims[Symbol.VOCAB.value], dims)
+        hidden = resolve_dim(dims[Symbol.HIDDEN.value], dims)
+    except (KeyError, DimResolutionError):
+        return None
+    flops = GEMM.flops_func(tokens, vocab, hidden, bias=False)
+    bytes_moved = GEMM.bytes_func(tokens, vocab, hidden, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+    return "GEMM", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved, tokens * vocab
+
+
+def _moe_cost(
+    dims: dict[str, Any],
+    top_k: int | None,
+    intermediate_size: int | None,
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None, int] | None:
+    """GEMM cost of the gate_up_proj + down_proj of the SELECTED experts only.
+
+    ``top_k``/``intermediate_size`` come from the architecture's own MoE
+    config (``spec.num_experts_per_tok``, ``spec.moe_intermediate_size``), not
+    ``dims[Symbol.INTERMEDIATE]`` -- that key prefers a model's DENSE
+    ``intermediate_size`` (shared-expert / non-MoE layers) when both are
+    declared, which is the wrong width for the routed experts this costs.
+    """
+    if not top_k or not intermediate_size:
+        return None
+    try:
+        tokens = resolve_dim(dims["B"], dims) * resolve_dim(dims["S"], dims)
+        hidden = resolve_dim(dims[Symbol.HIDDEN.value], dims)
+    except (KeyError, DimResolutionError):
+        return None
+    active_tokens = tokens * top_k
+    gate_up_flops = GEMM.flops_func(
+        active_tokens, 2 * intermediate_size, hidden, bias=False
+    )
+    gate_up_bytes = GEMM.bytes_func(
+        active_tokens, 2 * intermediate_size, hidden, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe
+    )
+    down_flops = GEMM.flops_func(active_tokens, hidden, intermediate_size, bias=False)
+    down_bytes = GEMM.bytes_func(
+        active_tokens, hidden, intermediate_size, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe
+    )
+    flops = gate_up_flops + down_flops
+    bytes_moved = None if bpe is None else gate_up_bytes + down_bytes
+    return "MoE", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved, tokens * hidden
+

+def _split_shape_text(text: str) -> tuple[list[str], str | None]:
+    """Split a drawn ``"[B, S, 4096] bfloat16"`` attr into (dims, dtype).
+
+    The dims list itself holds comma-separated, space-containing dims (``[B,
+    S, 4096]``), so the dtype suffix has to split on the closing bracket, not
+    on the first space.
+    """
+    stripped = text.strip()
+    if not stripped.startswith("["):
+        return parse_shape_dims(stripped), None
+    dims_part, bracket, dtype_part = stripped.partition("]")
+    return parse_shape_dims(dims_part + bracket), dtype_part.strip() or None
+
+
+def _dispatch_op_cost(
+    computation: str,
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    """Return ``(category, maf_type, flops, bytes)`` for an op, or ``None`` if unmodeled."""
+    if computation in _GEMM_NN_MODULE_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _gemm_cost_linear(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if computation.lower() in _GEMM_FUNCTIONAL_LABELS:
+        return _gemm_cost_matmul(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if computation == _SDPA_COMPUTATION:
+        return _sdpa_cost(input_shapes, bpe)
+    normalization_family = _classify_normalization(computation)
+    if normalization_family is not None:
+        kind, has_bias, channel_first = normalization_family
+        return _normalization_cost(
+            computation, kind, has_bias, channel_first, output_shape, bpe
+        )
+    if computation == _SOFTMAX_COMPUTATION:
+        return _softmax_cost(output_shape, bpe)
+    label = computation.lower()
+    if label in _REDUCTION_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _reduce_cost(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if label in _BINARY_POINTWISE_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _binary_elementwise_cost(input_shapes, output_shape, bpe)
+    if label in _UNARY_POINTWISE_COMPUTATIONS:
+        return _unary_elementwise_cost(output_shape, bpe)
+    return None
+

+def _gemm_cost_linear(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not input_shapes or not input_shapes[0] or not output_shape:
+        return None
+    input_shape = input_shapes[0]
+    k = input_shape[-1]
+    n = output_shape[-1]
+    m = prod(output_shape[:-1]) if len(output_shape) > 1 else 1
+    flops = GEMM.flops_func(m, n, k, bias=False)
+    bytes_moved = GEMM.bytes_func(m, n, k, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+    return "GEMM", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+
+
+def _gemm_cost_matmul(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if len(input_shapes) < 2:
+        return None
+    a_shape, b_shape = input_shapes[0], input_shapes[1]
+    if not a_shape or not b_shape or not output_shape:
+        return None
+    k = a_shape[-1]
+    n = b_shape[-1]
+    m = prod(output_shape[:-1]) if len(output_shape) > 1 else 1
+    flops = GEMM.flops_func(m, n, k, bias=False)
+    bytes_moved = GEMM.bytes_func(m, n, k, False, bpe, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+    return "GEMM", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+

+def _sdpa_cost(
+    input_shapes: list[tuple[int, ...] | None],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if len(input_shapes) < 3:
+        return None
+    q_shape, k_shape, v_shape = input_shapes[0], input_shapes[1], input_shapes[2]
+    if not q_shape or not k_shape or not v_shape:
+        return None
+    if len(q_shape) < 4 or len(k_shape) < 4 or len(v_shape) < 4:
+        return None
+    # [B, heads, seq, head_dim], per the graph's own SDPA shape rule.
+    b, h_q, n_q, d_h_qk = q_shape[-4:]
+    _, h_kv, n_kv, _ = k_shape[-4:]
+    d_h_v = v_shape[-1]
+    causal = n_q == n_kv
+    flops = SDPA.flops_func(b, n_q, h_q, n_kv, h_kv, d_h_qk, d_h_v, causal)
+    bytes_moved = (
+        SDPA.bytes_func(b, n_q, h_q, n_kv, h_kv, d_h_qk, d_h_v, causal, bpe)
+        if bpe is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    return "SDPA", "matrix", flops, bytes_moved
+

+def _normalization_cost(
+    computation: str,
+    kind: str,
+    has_bias: bool,
+    channel_first: bool,
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:
+    if not output_shape:
+        return None
+    num_elems = prod(output_shape)
+    if channel_first and len(output_shape) > 1:
+        num_channels = output_shape[1]
+    else:
+        num_channels = output_shape[-1]
+    if not num_channels:
+        return None
+    is_affine = True
+    if kind == "rmsnorm":
+        flops = _rmsnorm_flops(num_elems, num_channels, is_affine)
+        bytes_moved = (
+            _rmsnorm_bytes(num_elems, num_channels, is_affine, bpe, bpe)
+            if bpe is not None
+            else None
+        )
+    else:
+        flops = Normalization.flops_func(
+            has_bias, is_affine, False, num_elems, num_channels
+        )
+        bytes_moved = (
+            Normalization.bytes_func(
+                has_bias, is_affine, False, num_elems, num_channels, bpe, bpe
+            )
+            if bpe is not None
+            else None
+        )

+
+
+def _rmsnorm_flops(num_elems: int, num_channels: int, is_affine: bool) -> float:
+    """Mirrors RMSNorm.flops() in TraceLens.PerfModel.perf_model (no static
+    flops_func exists there -- RMSNorm overrides the instance method directly)."""
+    non_normalized_elems = num_elems / num_channels
+    flops = non_normalized_elems * (2 * num_channels + 2)
+    flops += num_elems * (2 if is_affine else 1)
+    return flops
+
+
+def _rmsnorm_bytes(
+    num_elems: int, num_channels: int, is_affine: bool, bpe_in: float, bpe_out: float
+) -> float:
+    """Mirrors RMSNorm.bytes() in TraceLens.PerfModel.perf_model."""
+    return (
+        num_elems * bpe_in
+        + num_elems * bpe_out
+        + (num_channels * bpe_in if is_affine else 0)
+    )
+
+
+def _softmax_cost(
+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,
+) -> tuple[str, str, float, float | None] | None:

+    m = prod(output_shape[:-1]) if len(output_shape) > 1 else 1

+    bytes_moved = Softmax.bytes_func(m, n, bpe) if bpe is not None else None
+    return "Softmax", "vector", flops, bytes_moved

+    output_shape: tuple[int, ...],
+    bpe: float | None,

+    if not output_shape:
+        return None
+    nelems = prod(output_shape)

+    bytes_moved = (
+        BinaryElementwise.bytes_func(nelems_in1, nelems_in2, nelems_out, bpe, bpe, bpe)
+        if bpe is not None
+        else None
+    )
+    return "BinaryElementwise", "vector", flops, bytes_moved
+

+
+# Project a model's roofline from its checkpoint alone
+```{meta}
+:description: Project a kernel-by-kernel roofline for a whole model from its checkpoint config and modeling source, with no trace or GPU run.
+:keywords: TraceLens, roofline, FLOPS, GEMM, SDPA, Normalization, static analysis, sizing study, no trace, ROCm, MI300X
+```
+
+`TraceLens_model_roofline_projection` builds the same merged Model Explorer
+graph as `TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer` (statically parsing
+`modeling_*.py` instead of executing any model code), maps every op with a
+direct [`TraceLens.PerfModel`](./perf-model-without-trace.md) formula to its
+FLOPs/bytes, and prints a kernel-by-kernel roofline table plus a model-level
+rollup — no trace and no GPU run required. Reusing the same graph means a
+`--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` split draws, and costs, the exact per-GPU local shapes the
+viewer would show for that split, not a second, independently-matched
+approximation of it.
+
+## Before you begin
+
+Confirm you have the following before continuing.
+
+- [TraceLens installed](../install/install.md).
+- A Hugging Face model id or local checkpoint directory with a `config.json`
+  and `modeling_*.py` (see `--github` below for checkpoints that don't ship
+  their own modeling source).
+
+## Run the tool
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_model_roofline_projection meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B \
+    --batch-size 1 --seq-len 4096 \
+    --gpu-arch-name MI300X
+```
+
+This prints a table ranked by projected roofline time, one row per op in a
+representative decoder layer (each annotated with that op's own repeat count —
+the merged graph's own tile count for the structural variant it sits in, so a
+hybrid layer mix like MoE-every-few-layers is already attributed per-variant,
+not spread evenly across every layer), plus ops outside the repeated layer
+stack (embedding, LM head) at their own single-instance cost. A rollup line
+reports total FLOPs/bytes, the compute-bound vs. memory-bound time split, and
+what fraction of the model's output elements were actually modeled.
+
+## Projecting one GPU's share of a sharded deployment
+
+Add `--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` to project one GPU's own share of the work under a
+tensor-/pipeline-/expert-parallel split, the same split
+`TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer` draws:
+
+```bash
+TraceLens_model_roofline_projection MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.1-Flash \
+    --engine vllm --tp 2 --ep 4 \
+    --batch-size 1 --seq-len 2048 \
+    --gpu-arch-name MI325X
+```
+
+The split itself comes from the checkpoint's declared `base_model_tp_plan`/
+`base_model_pp_plan`/`base_model_ep_plan` (Hugging Face), or, with `--engine
+vllm`/`--engine sglang`, from that inference engine's own parallel-layer
+classes (`ColumnParallelLinear`, `RowParallelLinear`, `QKVParallelLinear`, a
+`FusedMoE`'s expert count, ...) — including a model-specific subclass of one of
+these. Each GEMM is costed at its per-GPU local shape (a column-sharded
+projection's output divided by the TP count, an expert stack's expert count
+divided by the EP count, ...), derived by re-running the real shape-inference
+engine against a locally-divided config, not by guessing which axis a shape
+text happens to match. `1` on any of `--tp`/`--pp`/`--ep` leaves that axis
+unsplit (the default: a single, unsharded GPU).
+
+Without `--gpu-arch-name`/`--gpu-arch-json-path`, FLOPs and bytes are still
+reported but no roofline time is computed (no hardware peaks to bound against).
+
+## Flags
+
+- `--batch-size`, `--seq-len`: the shape to project at (default: 1, 2048).
+- `--dim KEY=VALUE` (repeatable): override a specific symbolic dimension
+  (e.g. `--dim past_len=1024`); takes precedence over `--batch-size`/`--seq-len`
+  for the same key.
+- `--gpu-arch-name NAME`: a bundled GPU arch spec (`MI300X`, `MI325X`, ...).
+- `--gpu-arch-json-path PATH`: a custom GPU arch JSON (same schema).
+- `--output-csv PATH` / `--output-json PATH`: write the full per-op table (JSON
+  also includes the rollup).
+- `--top-n N`: rows printed to stdout (default: 20; `0` for all).
+
+## Model source and runtime regime flags
+
+The checkpoint-provenance flags (`--github`, `--config-path`, `--code-path`,
+`--basic-op-add`/`--basic-op-remove`, `--meta-shapes`/`--no-meta-shapes`), the
+runtime-regime flags (`--phase`, `--cache`, `--sequence-layout`, `--attention`,
+`--mode`, `--device`, `--config-override`), and the device-partition flags
+(`--engine`, `--tp`, `--pp`, `--ep`) are the same ones
+`TraceLens_visualize_model_in_explorer` supports, since both tools build the
+checkpoint's graph through the same backend — run
+`TraceLens_model_roofline_projection --help` for the full list.
+
+Unlike the Model Explorer export, this tool always stops AST expansion exactly
+at ops with a direct `TraceLens.PerfModel` formula (`Linear`, the Normalization
+family, `Softmax`, ...) rather than expanding into their internal primitive
+steps — there is no `--stop-at-roofline-ops` flag here because turning it off
+would only replace a correctly-costed op with several the projection has no
+formula for.
+
+## Op coverage and approximations
+
+Costed op families: GEMM (`Linear`/`matmul`/`bmm`, including a vLLM/SGLang
+`*ParallelLinear`/`ReplicatedLinear` class or a model-specific subclass of
+one), SDPA, the Normalization family (RMSNorm, LayerNorm, GroupNorm,
+BatchNorm, InstanceNorm — matched by subclass name, since real checkpoints
+almost always subclass these), Softmax, generic elementwise/reduction ops, and
+MoE expert routing. A vLLM/SGLang `ParallelLMHead`/`FusedMoE` boundary — read
+from the engine's own source, where shape_inference has no rule for either —
+is costed from the architecture's own dims (vocab, hidden,
+experts-per-token, expert intermediate size) instead of its node shape; see
+"Known approximations" below. Everything else — embeddings, convolutions,
+reshapes/transposes — is reported as **unmodeled** rather than silently
+dropped, so the rollup's coverage share tells you how much of the model the
+projection actually accounts for.
+
+Known approximations:
+
+- GEMM bias is assumed absent.
+- Every Normalization op is assumed affine; RMSNorm is assumed bias-free, every
+  other norm is assumed to have one.
+- SDPA is assumed causal exactly when the query and key/value sequence lengths
+  resolve equal (a self-attention prefill shape).
+- MoE routing is costed as `experts_per_tok` GEMM passes per token (the
+  gate_up_proj and down_proj of only the selected experts), never
+  `num_experts` passes. The router's own softmax/top-k selection and any
+  shared-expert add are not separately costed.
